## Active variables

**Code:**

````markdown
{{{< show-vars >}}}
````

**Result:**

{{< show-vars >}}

---

## Exact match — `.when-var`

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var type="detailed"}
Shown only when `type` equals `detailed`.
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var type="detailed"}
Shown only when `type` equals `detailed`.
:::

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var type="summary"}
Shown only when `type` equals `summary`. *(should not appear)*
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var type="summary"}
Shown only when `type` equals `summary`.
:::

---

## Inverse — `.unless-var`

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.unless-var region="north"}
Shown in every region except `north`.
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.unless-var region="north"}
Shown in every region except `north`.
:::

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.unless-var region="south"}
Shown in every region except `south`. *(should not appear)*
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.unless-var region="south"}
Shown in every region except `south`.
:::

---

## AND condition — multiple attributes

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var type="detailed" region="south"}
Shown only when `type` is `detailed` **and** `region` is `south`.
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var type="detailed" region="south"}
Shown only when `type` is `detailed` **and** `region` is `south`.
:::

---

## OR condition — pipe-separated values

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var type="detailed|summary"}
Shown when `type` is `detailed` **or** `summary`.
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var type="detailed|summary"}
Shown when `type` is `detailed` **or** `summary`.
:::

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var type="summary|draft"}
Shown when `type` is `summary` **or** `draft`. *(should not appear)*
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var type="summary|draft"}
Shown when `type` is `summary` **or** `draft`.
:::

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var year=">2025|<2020"}
Shown when `year` > 2025 **or** `year` < 2020. *(should not appear)*
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var year=">2025|<2020"}
Shown when `year` > 2025 **or** `year` < 2020.
:::

---

## Mixed — `.when-var` + `.unless-var`

When both classes are present, use `when-<var>` and `unless-<var>` prefixes to declare each condition explicitly.

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var .unless-var when-type="detailed" unless-region="north"}
Shown when `type` is `detailed` **and** `region` is not `north`.
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var .unless-var when-type="detailed" unless-region="north"}
Shown when `type` is `detailed` **and** `region` **is not** `north`.
:::

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var .unless-var when-type="detailed" unless-region="south"}
Shown when `type` is `detailed` **and** `region` is not `south`. *(should not appear)*
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var .unless-var when-type="detailed" unless-region="south"}
Shown when `type` is `detailed` **and** `region` is not `south`.
:::

---

## Boolean variable

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var active="true"}
Shown only when `active` is `true`.
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var active="true"}
Shown only when `active` is `true`.
:::

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var active="false"}
Shown only when `active` is `false`. *(should not appear)*
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var active="false"}
Shown only when `active` is `false`.
:::

---

## Numeric conditions

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var year=">2020"}
Shown when `year` > 2020.
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var year=">2020"}
Shown when `year` > 2020.
:::

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var year=">=2024"}
Shown when `year` >= 2024.
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var year=">=2024"}
Shown when `year` >= 2024.
:::

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var year="<2020"}
Shown when `year` < 2020. *(should not appear)*
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var year="<2020"}
Shown when `year` < 2020.
:::

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var year="<=2023"}
Shown when `year` <= 2023. *(should not appear)*
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var year="<=2023"}
Shown when `year` <= 2023.
:::

## Nested variables

Variables defined as nested mappings in `_variables.yml` are accessible with dot notation.

**`_variables.yml`:**

```yaml
report:
  audience: public
  level: 2
```

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var report.audience="public"}
Shown only when `report.audience` is `public`.
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var report.audience="public"}
Shown only when `report.audience` is `public`.
:::

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var report.level=">=2"}
Shown when `report.level` >= 2.
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var report.level=">=2"}
Shown when `report.level` >= 2.
:::

---

## Unknown variables emit a warning

A reference to a variable that does not exist evaluates to `false` (block hidden) and prints a warning to the console:

**Code:**

````markdown
::: {.when-var country="Brazil"}
Shown only when `country` equals `Brazil`. *(should not appear)*
:::
````

**Result:**

::: {.when-var country="Brazil"}
Shown only when `country` equals `Brazil`.
:::

**Console warning:**

[WARNING [conditional-vars]: unknown variable 'country' referenced in .when-var / .unless-var]{style="color: #e6b800; font-weight: 700;"}

## Tips

::: {.callout-tip}
Canonical way to use variables in Quarto:

**Code:**

```{yaml}
{{< var active >}}
```

**Result:**

{{< var active >}}
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
For inline R expressions, variables from `_variables.yml` can be made directly
available using a setup chunk:

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("yaml", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The R package 'yaml' is required. Install it with install.packages('yaml').")
}

load_vars <- function(file = "_variables.yml",
                             envir = knitr::knit_global()) {
  vars <- yaml::read_yaml(file)

  for (v in names(vars)) {
    if (exists(v, envir = envir, inherits = FALSE)) {
      warning(
        sprintf(
          "Variable '%s' from %s was not loaded because an object with this name already exists.",
          v, file
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      assign(v, vars[[v]], envir = envir)
    }
  }

  invisible(vars)
}

load_vars()
```

**Code:**

```{yaml}
`r active`
```

**Result:**

`r active`

**Code:**

```{yaml}
`r report$audience`
```

**Result:**

`r report$audience`
:::
